in_marathi.name: Vasudev
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vasudev हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vasudev means ‘all-pervading God.’ It is a compound name derived from two Sanskrit words: ‘vasu’ meaning ‘dwelling’ and ‘dev’ meaning ‘God.’ Thus, Vasudev can be translated as ‘the God who pervades all.’ This name is associated with Lord Vishnu, who is believed to be the preserver of the universe in Hinduism.
